svg.title: Travel time from Praça do Derby to a grid over the Recife metropolitan region, walking and by public transport
svg.desc: Two maps of the conurbation of Recife, from Igarassu to Cabo de Santo Agostinho, with the cells of a grid coloured by the median travel time from Praça do Derby at the morning peak: on the left walking, a patch of five kilometres around the square; on the right walking plus public transport, which within 90 minutes covers most of the built-up area. Within an hour, 8% of the region's residents are reached on foot and 53% by public transport.

g.text: Recife metropolitan region, cells 500 m apart; departures 07:00–07:59 on Tuesday 10 November
2026 (median). Within an hour: 8% of the region's 3.7 million residents on foot, 53% with
buses, metro and VLT; within 90 minutes, 17% and 85%. Blank: over 90 minutes, or no residents
Travel time from Praça do Derby to every inhabited cell

Transporte Metropolitano, GTFS v2026.10.26. Boundaries and population: IBGE, Censo 2022.
